history.title: The Kambata Story
history.subtitle: A Journey Through History, Culture & Identity
history.p1: Nestled among the green highlands, waterfalls, and fertile valleys of Southern Ethiopia, the Kambata people are a proud community with a rich cultural heritage that stretches back many centuries.
history.p2: Historians and oral traditions describe Kambata as one of Ethiopia's historic kingdoms, known for its strong social organization, agricultural excellence, vibrant traditions, and deep respect for community values.
history.p3: The story of Kambata is preserved not only in historical records but also in songs, oral traditions, ceremonies, and the collective memory of its people.

items.title: Ancient Kingdoms
items.desc: Traditional governance systems and strong cultural foundations shaped early Kambata society.

items.title: Agricultural Heritage
items.desc: Generations of farming communities transformed the fertile highlands into thriving agricultural landscapes.

items.title: Cultural Preservation
items.desc: Language, music, ceremonies, and traditional values continue to connect generations.

items.title: Modern Kambata
items.desc: Today Kambata proudly welcomes visitors while preserving its unique identity and heritage.

support.q1: How do I modify my booking?
support.a1: You can modify your booking up to 48 hours before the tour start time. Go to 'My Bookings', select your upcoming trip, and click 'Modify Schedule' or contact support.
support.a2: Full refunds are available for cancellations made at least 7 days before departure. Cancellations within 48 hours may be subject to a 50% fee.
support.a3: We accept Visa, MasterCard, Telebirr, and direct bank transfers (CBE, Dashen, Awash).
support.q4: Are flights included in the packages?
support.a4: Domestic flights within Ethiopia are often included in premium packages. International flights to Addis Ababa must be booked separately.
support.q5: What should I pack for a trekking tour?
support.a5: We recommend sturdy hiking boots, layers for cold mornings, sun protection, and a refillable water bottle. A detailed packing list will be available in your Booking Details page once confirmed.
